detail.longDescription: Unfortunately for me and my appallingly long TBR list, they still haven't invented a way to hand off my entire workload to a robot so I can curl up on the couch with my Border Collie mix and binge fantasy novels instead. But AI agents are the closest thing to it. AI agents work autonomously to accomplish tasks.
